svg.title: Hopf bundle overlap and exact latitude transport
svg.desc: On the equator the northern coordinate w travels counterclockwise while the southern coordinate v equals one over w and travels clockwise. At phi equal to pi over three, the marked coordinates are one half plus or minus i square root of three over two. The southern unit frame equals the northern frame times exp minus i phi. Below, the real and imaginary parts of exp minus i pi times one minus cosine theta are plotted without discarding either part. Holonomy is one at either pole and minus one at the equator. The polar angle runs from zero to pi radians. The pole values agree with constant-loop transport.
